critical_code_review_comments: security_checkpoint.py L160: `db.security_checkpoints.find_one({'pairing_pin': pin, 'active': True})` — PIN comparison is plaintext + unindexed. With only 1M possible 6-digit values, an attacker can brute force pair endpoints. Recommend (a) add unique index on pairing_pin, (b) add per-IP rate limiting on /checkpoint/pair (currently unlimited 401 attempts), and (c) consider storing pairing_pin hashed with a lookup-id field — but PIN-cleartext is acknowledged as needed by admin UI for display, so at minimum add rate limiting.
security_checkpoint.py L209-222: payload lookup tries wallet_badges twice (once for nfc, once for qr) with same shape — minor DRY duplication.
_resolve_subject lower()s the email in the fallback search (L235) but does not lower-case the bare-string match in earlier branches — case-sensitivity inconsistency.

/checkpoint/scan (L304) does not validate that the checkpoint is still active in time-sensitive way; cp.active is checked but a session bound to a checkpoint that was deactivated then reactivated still works — acceptable but worth documenting.
_audit() is called on create but not on delete/update/rotate-pin (L130/105/118 has only delete) — partial audit coverage; rotate-pin should be audited (high-value security action).
Frontend SecurityCheckpointPage receipt button contrast bug noted above.

Local fallback for ID image uses /app/backend/uploads/checkpoint-ids but route is documented as /api/uploads/ — confirm a static mount exists for that path or images become unviewable in low-cloud-availability mode.
